nodes.name: Job Complete Webhook
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set the webhook path (currently 'job-complete'). Expected JSON body: { customerName, customerEmail, jobType, businessName }

nodes.name: Wait 2 Hours
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Adjust wait time to suit your business. Default is 2 hours after job completion.

nodes.name: Generate Email with Groq
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Create a Header Auth credential named 'Groq API Key'. Header: Authorization, Value: Bearer YOUR_GROQ_API_KEY

nodes.name: Prepare Email Content
nodes.notes: Extracts Groq-generated email body, builds subject line, merges with customer data. Falls back to template if Groq fails.

nodes.name: Send Email via Brevo
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Create a Header Auth credential named 'Brevo API Key'. Replace YOUR_SENDER_EMAIL with your verified Brevo sender address.

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set documentId to your Google Sheet ID. Tab must be named 'Review Requests' with columns: Timestamp, Customer Name, Customer Email, Job Type, Business Name, Email Subject, Status

nodes.name: Telegram Confirmation
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set chatId to your Telegram Chat ID.
